SEARCH
程序包 org.bukkit

接口 Registry<T extends Keyed>

类型参数:
T - 注册表中项目的类型

原文：type of item in the registry

所有超级接口:
java.lang.Iterable<T>
@NullMarked public interface Registry<T extends Keyed> extends java.lang.Iterable<T>
表示可以通过 NamespacedKey 检索的 Bukkit 对象注册表。

原文： Represents a registry of Bukkit objects that may be retrieved by NamespacedKey.

    • getKeyOrThrow

      default NamespacedKey getKeyOrThrow(T value)
      Gets the key for this object or throws if it doesn't exist.

      Some types can exist without being in a registry and such will have no key associated with them. This method throw an exception if it isn't in this registry.

      参数:
      value - the value to get the key of in this registry
      返回:
      the key for the value
      抛出:
      java.util.NoSuchElementException - if the value doesn't exist in this registry
      另请参阅:
      • getKey(Keyed)

    • getKey

      @Nullable NamespacedKey getKey(T value)
      Get the key for this object.

      Some types can exist without being in a registry and such will have no key associated with them. This method will return null.

      参数:
      value - the value to get the key of in this registry
      返回:
      the key for the value or null if not in the registry
      另请参阅:
      • getKeyOrThrow(Keyed)

    • getOrThrow

      default T getOrThrow(NamespacedKey key)
      通过键获取对象。 如果没有具有给定键的对象，将抛出异常。

      原文： Get the object by its key.

      If there is no object with the given key, an exception will be thrown.

      参数:
      key - 用于获取对象的键。

      原文：to get the object from

      返回:
      具有给定键的对象。

      原文：object with the given key

      抛出:
      java.util.NoSuchElementException - if there is no object with the given key

    • match

      @Deprecated(forRemoval=true) default @Nullable T match(java.lang.String input)
      已过时, 待删除: 此 API 元素将从以后的版本中删除。
      this method's behavior is broken and not useful. If you want to get an object based on its vanilla name, or a key, wrap it in a NamespacedKey object and use get(NamespacedKey)
      尝试将注册对象与给定键匹配。

      将尝试根据提供的输入找到合理的匹配，可能通过未指定的方式进行。

      原文： Attempts to match the registered object with the given key.

      This will attempt to find a reasonable match based on the provided input and may do so through unspecified means.

      注册对象，如果不存在则返回 null。 原文： Attempts to match the registered object with the given key.
